svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: LeetCode Rating Predictor
svg.desc: LeetCode Rating Predictor. 11 components in 2 groups. Connections: Chrome extension to LeetCode ranking JSON (ranks); Chrome extension to LeetCode GraphQL (histories, same origin); Chrome extension to Hugging Face Hub (model.json); Web app to FastAPI (same origin); Keep-warm job to FastAPI (/api/health); FastAPI to Rate limiter; FastAPI to TTL cache; FastAPI to LeetCode GraphQL (on cache miss); FastAPI to Dense network; Model artifacts to Dense network (loaded at startup).

text.tspan: Render serves the web app and the API; the extension runs the same model in your browser
